rationale: Record Pulp-owned browser-capture coordination that derives a bounded viewport from the authored panel, reloads the same Chromium target once, and revalidates the authored frame before sidecar collection and after stable browser pixels are accepted. The opt-in internal seam reduces duplicate capture work for existing Pulp and Forge import flows without changing Vellum source authority, the accepted expansion boundary, or public import behavior.
tests: browser capture authored-frame Chromium integration (5 cases)
independent pre-sidecar and accepted-pixel mutation controls
